name: postobon.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 25 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.postobon.com scores 49 out of 100 (F). 8 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 74 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 25 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /la-compania/quienes-somos, /la-compania/la-historia, /la-compania/gobierno-corporativo, /la-compania/organizacion-ardila-lule and 21 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 10 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /informacion-financiera/informacion-financiera-2014 answered 404, linked from /, /formulario/servicio-al-cliente-internacional and 4 more. /la-compania/haz-parte-del-talento-postobon answered 404, linked from /. /formulario/terminos-y-condiciones answered…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 248 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 38 elements on /, /formulario/servicio-al-cliente-internacional, /formulario/rosita, for example .menu-top-contact > .menu > .first.leaf > a and .menu-top-contact > .menu > .leaf:nth-child(2) > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The page fits a 390 px phone screen
The start page arrived in 238 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
